**Subject: Non-Delivery Claim – [Your Name] / [Order Number]**

Dear [Seller's Name],

I am writing to formally register my complaint regarding the item I purchased. Unfortunately, the item I received is not suitable for my needs, and I wish to claim a refund.

Please be advised that I have received the item, and I would like to collect a refund for the same product. I request that you process my refund immediately so that I may collect the item.
